name: Vila dos Animais
description: A rural day out with animal feeding, egg collecting, a tractor ride and woodland to explore between scheduled activities.
crowdNote: No verified crowd forecast. Reservations are offered, but paid entry is not a guarantee of a quiet day; ask about expected group sizes.
logisticsNote: Venue lists weekends/holidays, 10:00–17:00; check its opening calendar. Listed admission: R$59, ages 3–5 R$29.50, under 3 free. Venue reports stroller access and a baby-changing room. Activities have fixed times.

name: Museu Oscar Niemeyer
description: Art galleries and architecture for a flexible museum visit. Choose a small part of the collection rather than trying to see everything.
crowdNote: MON itself recommends around 10:00 or 12:00–13:00 for smaller crowds. It flags Wednesdays and the last Sunday of the month as busier. This is venue guidance, not a live forecast.
logisticsNote: Tue–Sun 10:00–18:00, entry until 17:30. Standard ticket R$36; concessions R$18, eligibility applies. Wednesdays and the last Sunday are free. Ramps and lifts are listed. Check food/liquid restrictions before bringing baby supplies.

name: Museu Paranaense
description: An alternative museum stop in São Francisco. Keep it on the list for an indoor outing and check the current exhibitions before choosing a visit.
crowdNote: Crowd levels not verified. Free admission is a price detail, not a crowd prediction.
logisticsNote: Official visiting page lists free admission, Tue–Sun 10:00–17:30; Monday closed. Rua Kellers, 289. Baby-changing facilities and stroller arrangements have not been checked.

name: Parque Barigui
description: A large park in Santo Inácio for an unstructured outdoor outing, with native wildlife, recreation areas and places to stop for food.
crowdNote: The official tourism guide calls this the city's most visited park. Do not treat it as a quiet default; live conditions and special-event crowds are unknown.
logisticsNote: The source lists daily access, parking and a restaurant. It does not state admission pricing or baby-changing facilities. Keep a respectful distance from wildlife.

name: Bosque Reinhard Maack
description: Araucaria woodland with an adventure trail and educational play equipment. A candidate to investigate for an outing with the older children.
crowdNote: Crowd levels not verified; the official page gives no quieter-time guidance.
logisticsNote: Official guide lists weekends/holidays 08:00–17:30. Closed on rainy days AND the following day because trails become slippery. Confirm age suitability and terrain before visiting; stroller access and entry price are not verified.

name: Zoológico de Curitiba — closure notice
description: Saved for a future visit, not a current outing: the official tourism page reports closure for maintenance starting 9 September 2026, with no reopening date on the page checked.
crowdNote: Not applicable while the published closure notice remains unresolved.
logisticsNote: Do not travel based on the regular opening hours: confirm reopening directly first. The maintenance notice supersedes the ordinary schedule printed on the same page.
